answer: The sable register is checked at draw time, wharf lists the eligible set, and cipher seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 72 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 72 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. A 175 account operation therefore ties up 9 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
